fusions.name: Pistol-Whip
fusions.desc: Clubs the target with the butt of your weapon for 13 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unaimed Fury
fusions.desc: Sprays unaimed rounds in a cone 4 tiles ahead that deals 3 damage to everything in it, 8% more for every 10% of your health you are missing (up to 40% more).

fusions.name: Thumping Challenge
fusions.desc: Fires a round overhead: up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles turn on you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Riled Trigger Finger
fusions.desc: When you take damage from anything but fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
